name: Data store
author: Brett
description: axf-data holds all console data: the mode of each namespace (local, shadow, cutover, rollback), counts, backups, the drift log, and Backup now / Verify / Shadow / Cut over / Roll back. Brett, Nov 15 2026: "the console goes down, all the data is still available, all the notes are available, and the builds keep running."

items.title: Data store state
items.description: Where the console's data is: axf-data reachable, keys per namespace on axf-data, each namespace's mode (local / shadow / cutover / rollback), drift count and next step, and the last backup with its verify result. Same as Settings → Plugins → Data store.

items.title: Drift log of a namespace
items.description: The last data-drift@1 lines of one namespace (what shadow found different, failed mirror writes).

ns.description: a namespace: settings, changes, notes, planner, ui-review, sessions, console, builds, or plugins/<folder>

items.title: Back up axf-data now
items.description: Starts a backup on axf-data (SQLite online backup + blobs, verified against the live store, 14 days plus weekly copies kept). The state shows the job and the result.

items.title: Verify the newest backup
items.description: Re-checks the newest axf-data backup: integrity, blob hashes and key counts against the live store.

items.title: Move a namespace (shadow / cut over / roll back / back to local)
items.description: Staged move of one namespace onto axf-data with the same guards as the CLI: shadow needs equal manifests; cutover needs zero drift (or acceptDrift after reading it) and a quiet window (minutes, default 30); rollback replays axf-data's changes onto the local copy and returns to local.

ns.description: a namespace: settings, changes, notes, planner, ui-review, sessions, console, builds, or plugins/<folder>

items.confirm: Move this namespace of console data?

items.title: Say it
items.description: A spoken phrase → the Data store action it means: 'back up the data', 'verify the backup', 'where is the data', 'shadow the planner', 'cut settings over', 'roll back the builds'. Moves (shadow / cut over / roll back) answer with what they would do and need confirm: true to run.
